gen_vocab: train a SentencePiece BPE vocabulary model from a text file and export a fairseq dictionary
extract_fbank_features: extract Kaldi-compliant fbank features from a waveform tensor and optionally save to numpy file
create_zip: create a zip archive of all numpy and flac files in a data directory
get_zip_manifest: generate a manifest of paths and lengths for all files inside a zip archive
gen_config_yaml: generate a speech-to-text data configuration YAML file with vocab, specaugment, and CMVN settings
